item.text:
Hi [Colleague’s Name],

I’m sorry your idea wasn’t credited during today’s meeting. That was an oversight on my part, and I understand how frustrating and unfair it may have felt. I’ll correct this by acknowledging your contribution in the meeting summary and informing the team that the proposal originated with you. I’ll also make sure to credit contributors explicitly in future discussions. Thank you for raising the idea—I appreciate the value you brought to the conversation.
